issues.detail: The case states recovery inactive although an acceptance change after a COMPLETE review implies a rework frame (catalog issue). The fixture resolves this coherently: USER_REWORK interrupted REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION before the Reviewer's handoff, Frame 1 RerunThrough TESTING, popped by Tester's RESUME into REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. Records and STATE agree.

expectCheck is ok:false (stale COMPLETE review does not account for AC-004) while the catalog says deliberately_invalid false. This is inherent to the case, which requires a stale COMPLETE review alongside a new AC-004. The turn-end check accepts the state, so check_ok remains meaningful.

The scope's AC-003 entry is 'Retired before this revision was completed', a README variant replaced within the same REPLAN. It exists only to make the new ID AC-004. It is slightly odd but harmless and consistent with id.mjs numbering.

complete:true rests on the report changing and mentioning AC-004. A shallow edit that appends AC-004 would pass without a judge. However, both checks are necessary for any correct run, and adding the AC-004 disposition is itself the reconciliation the assertion targets, so the risk of a false pass is small.
issues.fix: Optionally set complete:false so the judge confirms the report was actually reconciled.
